title: Amazon PPC Executive
description:
Amazon PPC Executive

Location: Milton Keynes

Our client is looking for an Amazon PPC Executive to join their team on a full time permeant basis. As an Amazon PPC Executive, you will be at the forefront of managing and optimising Amazon advertising campaigns to drive traffic and sales. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, analytical skills, and strong communication abilities. You will play a pivotal role in the company's marketing efforts, ensuring that advertising campaigns are performing optimally and contributing to the business's success.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
- Conduct keyword research to identify relevant and high-traffic keywords for ad campaigns.
- Create and launch PPC campaigns on Amazon using tools such as Amazon Advertising Console.
- Write compelling ad copy that accurately represents the product and entices customers to click.
- Monitor and adjust bids to ensure optimal campaign performance while staying within budget.
- Analyse campaign data and make adjustments to improve performance, such as targeting and ad placement.
- Produce reports that clearly communicate campaign results and insights to the team.
- Conduct A/B tests to determine the most effective ad copy, keywords, and targeting strategies.
- Manage advertising budgets to align spending with business goals and objectives.
- Analyse competitor advertising campaigns to identify opportunities and threats.
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and changes to Amazon's advertising platform.

Skills and Experience:
- Proven expertise in PPC advertising principles and best practices.
- Strong analytical skills to analyse campaign performance data and produce insightful reports.
- Knowledge of keyword research tools and techniques.
- Ability to write compelling and effective ad copy.
- Experience managing bid strategies and budgets for optimal campaign performance.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across various teams.
- Attention to detail to ensure campaigns are set up and managed correctly.
- A willingness to stay current with industry trends and changes.

Company Benefits:
- Casual dress
- On-site parking
- Regular social events including summer and end-of-year parties
- Spontaneous employee well-being treats
- Vouchers at Christmas to shop with the company
- Private medical insurance
- Gym membership discounts

- A sense of ownership: you'll see your area as your own business & love to roll up your sleeves & get stuck into building & leading your platform & brands growth

title: International Marketing Operations Manager
description:
International Marketing Operations Manager

Job Type: Temporary
Location: Marlow (hybrid working available)
Duration: 12 months

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced International Marketing Operations Manager to lead and optimise promotional review processes across international markets. This role will act as a key partner to marketing, medical, legal, regulatory and compliance stakeholders, ensuring the efficient review, approval and management of promotional materials for pharmaceutical and/or medical device products. The successful candidate will combine strong project management expertise with a thorough understanding of MLR processes, compliance requirements and promotional review systems to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead and facilitate cross-functional Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR) review meetings, managing agendas, stakeholder feedback and approval workflows.
- Manage promotional review activities for assigned brands, ensuring materials progress efficiently through review and approval stages.
- Act as a subject matter expert for promotional review processes and systems, supporting users and driving adherence to company procedures and industry regulations.
- Collaborate closely with marketing, medical, regulatory, compliance and operational teams to ensure timely preparation, submission and approval of promotional materials.
- Lead process improvement initiatives and special projects to enhance review efficiency, materials management and operational effectiveness.
- Analyse process performance, identify opportunities for innovation and support wider Marketing Operations projects and business initiatives.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, with a minimum of 5 years' experience within pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences marketing operations.
- Strong understanding of MLR review processes, promotional compliance requirements and pharmaceutical advertising regulations, including ABPI guidance.
- Experience working with promotional review platforms such as Veeva PromoMats or similar content management and approval systems.
- Demonstrated project management experience with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver to tight deadlines.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and meeting facilitation skills with experience working across international cross-functional teams.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook, with the ability to analyse data and produce clear business communications.

What's on Offer

This is an excellent opportunity to join a highly collaborative global organisation, where you will play a pivotal role in driving compliant promotional excellence, influencing international stakeholders and leading initiatives that improve marketing operations across multiple markets.

Marketing and Content Coordinator

Location: Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire

Salary: 26,000 - 28,000 Pro Rata (2 days per week)

Working arrangement: Based in Milton Keynes, with travel to live events and occasional evening or weekend work

MFK Recruitment is recruiting a Marketing and Content Coordinator to join a well-established and creative business specialising in live events, event production and experiential projects.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, organised and commercially minded marketing professional who enjoys producing engaging content, developing marketing campaigns and seeing their work come to life.

The successful candidate will take ownership of the company's day-to-day marketing activity, capturing content from live events, developing its digital presence and supporting business growth through targeted marketing campaigns.

You will have the opportunity to get behind the scenes of live events, capture the work being delivered and turn it into engaging content that showcases the company's creativity, expertise and capabilities.

Alongside content creation, you will help identify new markets, develop targeted campaigns and support the company's ongoing commercial growth.

Marketing and Content Creation
- Plan, manage and maintain the company's marketing and content calendar.
- Create engaging content for social media, websites, email campaigns and other digital platforms.
- Write and edit compelling copy for marketing materials, advertising, case studies and promotional campaigns.
- Design graphics and social media assets using Canva, Adobe or similar creative software.
- Attend live events, rehearsals, production builds and other activities to gather behind-the-scenes content.

- Manage social media content, including planning, scheduling, publishing and engagement.

- Coordinate photography, filming and interviews with colleagues, clients and venues.

- Previous experience in marketing, content creation, digital marketing or communications.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong copywriting and proofreading abilities.
- Experience creating engaging content for social media and digital platforms.
- Practical experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design software.
- A full UK driving licence and valid passport.

Desirable Experience
- Previous marketing experience within live events, event production, creative agencies or a B2 B environment.
- Experience producing marketing content at live events.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys marketing and content creation, rather than simply managing social media accounts.

You will be naturally curious, confident in communicating with different teams and comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial ideas through to delivery.

The ideal candidate will be creative enough to spot a great content opportunity, organised enough to deliver it on time and commercially aware enough to understand how marketing contributes to business growth.

An interest in live events, production, design or the wider creative industries would be particularly beneficial.

title: Marketing Manager
description:

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, the Marketing Manager will play a key role in delivering marketing activities and campaigns across Connells Group's core brands, including Sales, Lettings and Auctions.

The role is responsible for managing the day-to-day planning, execution, optimisation and reporting of integrated marketing activity that supports lead generation, brand awareness, customer engagement and commercial growth. Working collaboratively with stakeholders across the business, the Marketing Manager will ensure campaigns are delivered effectively, aligned to business objectives and achieve measurable results.

Hope After Harm is a Buckinghamshire based registered Charity and Charitable Company Limited by Guarantee of 32 years' operating a range of support programmes across the Thames Valley - including support for victims, support for the families of offenders, early interventions, work in the field of domestic abuse and support to offenders. With 40 staff and approximately 30 volunteers, a solid Trustee framework is essential to underpin and inform our work and our Trustees currently bring together considerable experience from criminal justice, local government, the corporate and voluntary sectors.

We have a very exciting vacancy we wish to fill, to complement our existing Board and guide our successful and growing organisation into the next phase of development. This is an opportunity to use your professional skills to support a charity delivering meaningful impact across the Thames Valley.

Hope After Harm is relatively small, trustees can see the direct results of their contribution and frontline impact, we require general Trustee experience, to expand the knowledge base and help strengthen the Board overall, we are also specifically looking for those with experience in the following areas:

For the Marketing, Communications and PR Trustee position, your role will be:
- Advise the Board on communications, media, marketing and reputation matters.
- Provide strategic oversight of Hope After Harm's brand, profile and public positioning.
- Offer constructive challenge on communications risks, including reputation, safeguarding, confidentiality and data protection.
- Support the Board to consider how communications can strengthen awareness, stakeholder confidence, fundraising and community engagement.
- Provide guidance on the charity's approach to public statements, media interest and crisis communications.
- Champion communications that are sensitive to the experiences of survivors, families, young people and others affected by harm and trauma.
- Work with the CEO and staff team in an advisory capacity to support effective delivery

Person specification

The trustee should bring senior-level knowledge or experience across a number of the following areas:
- Public relations, media relations and strategic communications
- Brand management and brand consistency
- Crisis communications and reputation management
- Stakeholder engagement and public engagement
- Social media strategy and digital communications
- Content development across online and offline channels
- Awareness campaigns and community outreach
- Communications governance, including tone of voice, messaging and reputational risk

The successful candidate does not need to be an expert in every area, but should be able to provide strategic insight, constructive challenge and proportionate assurance to support the charity's work.

Time Commitment

The Trustee will be expected to attend Board Meetings 4 times a year (face to face) and also attend one committee meeting (Teams) 4 times a year, as well as attending a strategy day. The time commitment including meeting preparation is estimated to be 5-6 days per annum

Location

Ideally, the post-holder will be able to travel to Aston Sandford and possibly other places in the Thames Valley for meetings, but we would consider remote attendance, with the exception of a requirement for face-to-face attendance at the annual Board strategy day

If you have a passion and commitment to support a value-driven organisation, strategic vision, independent judgement and a willingness to devote the necessary time and effort we would be delighted to hear from you. Any travel and out of pocket expenses will be reimbursed but please note this is a voluntary and unpaid post.

Application Process:

Please email covering letter expressing your interest, with a CV of your skills.
